subject: Hospitality
title: TRevPAR: Total Revenue Per Room
description: Learn TRevPAR: Total Revenue Per Room in one minute.

hook.text: RevPAR only counts room revenue. But guests also spend on food, spa, parking, and events. TRevPAR captures ALL of it.

buildup.text: TRevPAR (Total Revenue Per Available Room) adds every revenue source: rooms, restaurants, bars, spa, meetings, retail.

discovery.text: A resort might have modest room rates but massive spa and dining revenue. TRevPAR reveals the full guest value.

twist.text: Casinos in Las Vegas can have negative room TRevPAR—rooms sold below cost—but massive casino TRevPAR from gambling revenue.

climax.text: TRevPAR pushes revenue managers to think beyond rooms. How do you maximize every dollar from every guest across the property?

punchline.text: Rooms are just the beginning. TRevPAR counts every dollar a guest spends.

quiz.question: How does TRevPAR differ from RevPAR?
options: TRevPAR includes all revenue sources—not just rooms
